question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is **"attribute."**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Attribute"** means to assign a quality or characteristic to someone or something. (कारण ठहरना, उत्तरदायी मानना, श्रेय देना)

 
 
• **Example**: *Kohli **attributes**__ his success to hard work.*
 
 
 
• It is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank as it fits the context of assigning something.
 
• The correct answer is Option 4.
 
• Correct passage:

The Great Depression was a severe __worldwide__ economic depression in the decade __preceding__ World War II. In most countries the depression __started__ in about 1929 and lasted until the late 1930s or early 1940s. It was the longest, most widespread, and deepest depression of the 20th century. In the 21st century, the Great Depression is commonly used as an example of how far the world's economy can __decline__ .The depression originated in the U.S. Economic historians usually __**attribute**__ the start of the Great Depression to the sudden devastating collapse of US stock market prices on 29 October 1929, known as Black Tuesday; some dispute this conclusion, and see the stock crash as a symptom, rather than a cause, of the Great Depression. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Merit**: The quality of being particularly good or worthy. ((किसी व्यक्ति या वस्‍तु का) लाभ या गुण)
 
• **Emblem**: A symbolic representation of something, often used to represent an organization or group. (प्रतीक वस्‍तु या चिह्न)
 
• **Assign**: To give someone a task or responsibility. (विशेष उद्देश्‍य से कुछ देना)
